name: Stock Movement Report
query:
SELECT 
    ste.name AS "Stock Entry ID",
    ste.posting_date AS "Posting Date",
    ste.purpose AS "Purpose",
    ste_item.item_code AS "Item Code",
    ste_item.item_name AS "Item Name",
    ste_item.qty AS "Quantity",
    ste_item.uom AS "UOM",
    ste_item.s_warehouse AS "Source Warehouse",
    ste_item.t_warehouse AS "Target Warehouse"
FROM 
    `tabStock Entry` ste
JOIN 
    `tabStock Entry Detail` ste_item ON ste.name = ste_item.parent
WHERE 
    ste.docstatus = 1  -- Only Submitted Entries
    AND ste.purpose = 'Material Transfer'
ORDER BY 
    ste.posting_date DESC;
